Review the clips in a local app

Source: R/app.R
run_app.Rd

Opens a 'shiny' app, in the browser, to review the clips of a manifest one at a time: the spectrogram and a player for each clip, its site, night, hour, score and design, and buttons to mark it positive, negative or uncertain. Each verdict is written at once to verdicts_file, so an interrupted session loses nothing and can be resumed. The app replaces moving the clips into Positive and Negative folders in the BirdNET GUI; app_verdicts() turns verdicts_file into the table that classify_review() returns.

Usage

run_app(
  manifest,
  clips_dir,
  verdicts_file = NULL,
  reviewer = NULL,
  max_freq = NULL,
  launch.browser = interactive(),
  ...
)

Arguments

manifest

Clip manifest: a data frame or the path to clip_manifest.csv (from select_clips(), cut_clips() or assign_reviewers()).

clips_dir

Folder of the cut clips, with one subfolder per species (<clips_dir>/<species_folder>/<clip_file>, as written by cut_clips()).

verdicts_file

CSV where the verdicts are written. By default, verdicts.csv next to manifest when it is a path.

reviewer

Name of the reviewer, written with each verdict. With a manifest from assign_reviewers(), only the clips assigned to this reviewer (as first or second reviewer) are shown.

max_freq

Optional upper limit of the spectrogram, in kHz (e.g. 8 for most anuran calls). The whole band by default.

launch.browser

Open the app in the browser? Passed to shiny::runApp().

...

Further arguments to shiny::runApp(), e.g. port.

Value

Called for its side effect; returns when the app is closed.

Details

The app runs on the reviewer's computer and reads the clips from disk; nothing is uploaded.

Keyboard

p positive, n negative, u uncertain, right arrow or space next clip, left arrow previous clip.

Verdicts file

A CSV with one line per click: clip_file, species_folder, reviewer, verdict ("positive", "negative" or "uncertain") and time. Lines are only appended; when a clip is marked again, the last verdict of the reviewer counts. Several reviewers can share one file or keep one each.

See also

app_verdicts(), vignette("review-app").

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
run_app("validation/clip_manifest.csv", "validation/clips",
        reviewer = "liliana")
} # }
